tns:patch.author: Alexandru Artimon
tns:patch.description: recreate view, this will always be the last version of the view

script.lang: SELECT settingsvalue FROM amp_global_settings where settingsname='Recreate the views on the next server restart';

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_indicator_actualvalue CASCADE; CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_indicator_actualvalue AS SELECT con.activity_id AS amp_activity_id, val.value AS name, ind.indicator_id AS me_indicator_id, --si.amp_sector_id AS me_indicator_sector_id, null::bigint AS me_indicator_sector_id, CASE ind.type WHEN 'A' THEN 1 :: BIGINT WHEN 'D' THEN 2 :: BIGINT ELSE 3 :: BIGINT END AS me_indicator_type_id, con.ind_val_category AS me_indicator_logframe_id, con.risk AS me_indicator_risk_id, t.amp_theme_id AS me_npo_id, acv.id AS category_value_id, acv.category_value AS category_value FROM amp_indicator_connection con JOIN amp_indicator ind ON ind.indicator_id = con.indicator_id --LEFT JOIN amp_sector_indicator si ON si.indicator_id=ind.indicator_id LEFT JOIN amp_theme t ON ind.program_id = t.amp_theme_id LEFT JOIN amp_theme t2 ON t.parent_theme_id = t2.amp_theme_id JOIN amp_indicator_values val ON val.ind_connect_id = con.id JOIN amp_indicator_disaggregation_values aidv ON ind.indicator_id = aidv.indicator_id JOIN amp_indicator_global_value aigv ON aidv.base_value_id = aigv.id JOIN amp_category_value acv ON acv.id = aidv.parent_category_id WHERE val.value_type = 1 AND con.sub_clazz::text = 'a'::text GROUP BY con.activity_id, val.value, ind.indicator_id, con.ind_val_category, con.risk, t.amp_theme_id, acv.id, acv.category_value ORDER BY amp_activity_id, name, me_indicator_id;
